title: PDF to Semantic HTML
sourceTableContract: The decorations command exports ruled and fill-partitioned tables with source page widths, cell spans, fills, individual borders, vertical alignment and uniform typography. JSON is flushed before exit.
summary: Converts born-digital PDFs to source-positioned HTML with source-derived typography, local assets, uniform page zoom in the reader and deterministic QA. Automatically prepares missing local runtime components before conversion. Preserves source paragraph borders through shared PDF drawing evidence. Detects and recovers flattened source lists with page-continuing numbering and source list typography. The decorations command exports isolated horizontal source rules for display-page consumers.
validationContract: Strict per-page text and punctuation; source table cells, recognized lists, clear paragraph gaps and sampled PNG correspondence; browser visibility checks; final-path validation with rollback; failed validate exits 1. Full visual fidelity and ambiguous source structure still require review.
